name: 85715 · Tucson, AZ
findings: ZIP 85715 (Tucson) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85715 (Tucson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 85715 (Tucson) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
